text: APPROVE. The extracted `BypassedCtorFqns` does the same filtering (Scala types only, non-empty `CtorFqn`) into an ordinal-comparer `HashSet<string>`, and moving those nested loops and ifs out should bring `BypassableInvariantEntities` well under 15. I could not build it here, so the one thing I'm assuming is that `IsScalaType` has no overloads that would make the `Where(IsScalaType)` method group ambiguous.
